Sources & Currency

Official price sources and optional currency display.

Sources
Croatia — DZS

Official price data
Published reuse terms

Attribution: Croatian Bureau of Statistics. Yugo Farmia calculations or modifications are identified.

Serbia — SORS

Official price data
Published reuse terms

Attribution: Statistical Office of the Republic of Serbia (SORS). Yugo Farmia calculations or modifications are identified.

Slovenia — SURS

Official price data
Published reuse terms

Attribution: Statistical Office of the Republic of Slovenia (SURS). Yugo Farmia calculations or modifications are identified.

Currency

Every source price is displayed in its original reported currency and unit. Users may optionally select another display currency for easier comparison. When conversion is available, Yugo Farmia calculates the displayed equivalent from the applicable stored CurrencyAPI rate and its recorded date. The converted amount is a derived display value; the original value remains the source value.
